summary: TORGHJØRNET AS (org. no. 977 515 890) is a private limited company (AS) based in Hamar, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-05-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 9.6 m and net income was -NOK 821 639. Board chair: Harald Rune Øyhovden; auditor: TELL NORGE AS. Also: LEI 2549004JIGSI4WV87R67, ultimate parent ØYVIG AS.
